digest.component_or_area: external live-services integration test tier / plan-review DET floor
propositions: The external live-services tier reports live_single_turn workflow status 'failed' and coverage.llm_ran is False, so live LLM calls are not made.

test_single_turn_live_structured_output fails because the test writes live-verdict.md into the working tree without committing it, and attested-snapshot gating reads the prompt from the HEAD snapshot which lacks it, yielding 'unknown prompt live-verdict'.

test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict fails because the stale plan fixture lacks a Testing/Verification section, causing p10_verification_presence to block and the DET-floor short-circuit to return BLOCK without running the LLM tier.
Both failures were previously masked by a SnapshotRefError until the bug 8070 fix let the tier reach its subject.
Root cause is test-side, not the provider seam: provider/model resolution reaches Anthropic correctly, so the fix commits the prompt override and adds a Testing section to the fixture.
A new default-tier reachability guard test is added so the dead guards can no longer silently pass in an unread weekly job.
